title: YouTube Channel Search Scraper input
description: Search public YouTube channels by free-text keyword. Returns channel cards (name, handle, subscribers, video count, verified). Optional About-page enrich. Not a mixed video SERP and not a known-URL channel scrape.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Free-text YouTube search terms used to find public channels, for example 'personal finance' or 'fitness coach'. Each query is searched independently and unique channels are merged. Prefills one example query. This is not a channel URL or @handle — for a known channel use youtube-channel-scraper.

searchUrls.title: YouTube results URLs
searchUrls.description: Optional youtube.com/results URLs that already contain a search_query, for example 'https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=lofi'. The Actor extracts the keyword and runs a channel-only search. Defaults to empty. This is not a /channel or @handle URL.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max channels per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum unique channels saved for each search query after pagination. Example: 10. Range 1–200; default 10. This is not a global run cap — see maxResultsTotal.

maxResultsTotal.title: Max channels per run
maxResultsTotal.description: Hard cap on unique channels billed and saved across every query in this run. Example: 50. Range 1–500; default 50. Extra matches after the cap are skipped. This is not the per-query limit.

minSubscribers.title: Minimum subscribers
minSubscribers.description: Keep channels whose public subscriber count is at least this number, for example 10000. Default 0 (no floor). Channels that hide subscriber counts are kept. This is not a YouTube API quota.

maxSubscribers.title: Maximum subscribers
maxSubscribers.description: Keep channels whose public subscriber count is at most this number, for example 1000000. Default 0 means no ceiling. Hidden counts are kept. This is not a billing cap.

verifiedOnly.title: Verified channels only
verifiedOnly.description: When true, keep only search cards that show YouTube's verified badge. Default false returns verified and unverified public channels. This does not confirm official brand ownership beyond the public badge.

country.title: Country (gl)
country.description: Defaults to 'US'. This is not a language code — see language. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

language.title: Language (hl)
language.description: Two-letter ISO language code used as YouTube interface language (hl), for example 'en' or 'es'. Defaults to 'en'. This is not a country code — see country.

enrichProfiles.title: Enrich channel profiles
enrichProfiles.description: VibeLeads scope: keep optional contact/detail extraction explicitly disabled during company discovery. A relevant stage for named qualified businesses requires verified actual build controls, source/use rights and suppression under the contact-use gate. Decline inseparable audience collection.
enrichProfiles.x-vibeleads-discovery: explicitly disabled; verify actual build, otherwise decline route

fallbackMode.title: Restricted access control
fallbackMode.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.
enumTitles: Auto (direct first, managed fallback last resort)

proxyConfiguration.title: Restricted access control
proxyConfiguration.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
